column2: [intro]
I'm a funny girl, you see
Always laughing endlessly
In my life, the ups and downs
Are the fuel for the words I crown
I want a story, brand new and bold
One that shakes the crowd and won't grow old
That lights up faces with fiery grins
And ignites joy that never dims
People think I'm out of my mind
But that, I leave far behind
I'm a spark of madness in this pot
And I'll stand out, give it all I've got
Give me a story, one wild and free
That makes my wings buzz with glee
And triggers applause from every hand
A roar that echoes through the land
[Solo]
I want a story, brand new and bold
One that shakes the crowd and won't grow old
That lights up faces with fiery grins
And ignites joy that never dims
[Outro]
